notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Skyknight Squire and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Skyknight Squire trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
